card.name: The word adverse before reactions
card.fires_on: The word "adverse" just before "reactions" or "events" in drug label warnings. It often follows a body-system word such as cardiovascular, cutaneous or anticholinergic.

modes.label: Adverse after a descriptor
modes.description: "adverse" follows a type of reaction such as cutaneous, renal or anticholinergic.
modes.example: If signs or symptoms suggest a severe cutaneous<< adverse>> reaction, use of this drug should not

modes.label: Adverse after other or prolong
modes.description: "adverse" follows a linking word like "other", "and" or "prolong" in interaction text.
modes.example: which could increase or prolong<< adverse>> reactions and may cause potentially fatal respiratory depression

card.plain: It marks the word "adverse" when a label is about to say "adverse reactions" or "adverse events".
